title: Number 137 in the proportions of the second pyramid

tellings.quote: You surely haven't failed to notice the correspondence with the number found in the proportions of the second pyramid of Giza.

plain: The number 137, which the physicists Richard Feynman and Leon Lederman wrote about as a puzzling constant of nature, also turns up in the proportions of the second pyramid at Giza, the one built for the pharaoh Khafre. So says a researcher named Armando Mei, who tells Michels that the listener "surely haven't failed to notice the correspondence." He offers it as his own reading, without naming a source, and the point would be that the pyramid's builders knew something of the physics behind that number.
